article.linkText: East Carolina hosts Temple in AAC action
article.story: Temple (2-5) at East Carolina (3-4), Oct. 31 at 3 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: East Carolina by 4.5. Against the spread: East Carolina 3-4, Temple 4-3. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats East Carolina Offense Overall: 351.1 yards per game (102nd in FBS) Passing: 194.6 yards per game (104th) Rushing: 156.6 yards per game (68th) Scoring: 25.0 points per game (94th) East Carolina Defense Overall: 349.0 yards per game (60th in FBS) Passing: 206.4 yards per game (63rd) Rushing: 142.6 yards per game (72nd) Scoring: 26.3 points per game (93rd) Temple Offense Overall: 386.0 yards per game (71st in FBS) Passing: 183.6 yards per game (114th) Rushing: 202.4 yards per game (26th) Scoring: 25.7 points per game (91st) Temple Defense Overall: 404.6 yards per game (114th in FBS) Passing: 238.7 yards per game (106th) Rushing: 165.9 yards per game (97th) Scoring: 28.0 points per game (104th) East Carolina is 129th in third down percentage, converting 31.0% of the time. East Carolina ranks 85th in the FBS averaging 60.1 penalty yards per game, compared to Temple's 7th-ranked 37.3 per-game average. East Carolina is 134th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 96.3% of trips. Temple's red zone offense ranks 35th, scoring on 89.5% of red zone opportunities. East Carolina is 127th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:14. Team leaders East Carolina Passing: Emory Williams, 716 yards, 7 TDs, 2 INTs, 62.4 completion percentage Rushing: TJ Engleman Jr., 582 yards on 89 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Ray Ray Joseph, 285 yards on 31 catches, 3 TDs Temple Passing: Ajani Sheppard, 1,127 yards, 8 TDs, 0 INTs, 61.7 completion percentage Rushing: Keveun Mason, 513 yards on 94 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Colin Chase, 308 yards on 18 catches, 2 TDs Last game East Carolina lost 41-34 to Memphis on Oct. 22. Mitch Griffis led East Carolina with 199 yards on 14-of-26 passing (53.8%) for one touchdown and two interceptions. Engleman had 92 rushing yards on 18 carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for three yards. Landon Sides recorded 130 yards on seven catches with one touchdown. Temple fell 38-31 to Charlotte on Oct. 17. Sheppard passed for 236 yards on 15-of-23 attempts (65.2%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 70 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Mason had 64 rushing yards on 13 carries and one touchdown, adding two receptions for nine yards. Peter Clarke put up 127 yards on five catches with one touchdown. Next game East Carolina hosts South Florida on Nov. 6. Temple plays at Navy on Nov. 7.
